description: This is a Kotlin source file defining an Android activity 'ContentInfoActivity' that displays detailed information about a content item, including metadata, background image, and action buttons. It manages UI initialization, populates views with content data, handles date/time display, and sets up focus-driven scaling for TV remote interactions.
